title: Penalties for spying and communicating defense secrets
verbatim_text: If any person for any purpose prejudicial to the safety or interests of the State: (a) approaches, inspects, passes over or is in the neighborhood of, or enters any prohibited place; or (b) makes any sketch, plan, model, or note calculated to be or intended to be directly or indirectly useful to an enemy; or (c) obtains, collects, records or publishes or communicates to any other person any secret official code or password, he shall be guilty of an offence under this section.
provisos: Provided that where the offence is committed in relation to any work of defence, arsenal, naval, military or air force establishment or station, the offence shall be punishable with death or with imprisonment for a term which may extend to fourteen years.
source_citation: Official Gazette of Pakistan / Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk), Official Secrets Act, 1923 (Act XIX of 1923)

title: Wrongful communication, etc., of official information
verbatim_text: If any person having in his possession or control any secret official code, password, sketch, plan, model, article, note, document or information which relates to or is used in a prohibited place, or which has been entrusted in confidence to him by any person holding office under the Government, willfully communicates the same to any person other than a person to whom he is authorized to communicate it, he shall be guilty of an offence.
source_citation: Official Gazette of Pakistan / Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk), Official Secrets Act, 1923 (Act XIX of 1923)
